name: zcuric
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Zdravko Curic.

plugins.name: pr-pipeline
plugins.description: Takes a ticket (Jira, GitHub issue, Linear, or the task in words) through nine recorded stages to a merge-ready PR, routes each stage to a model by task class, reviews with Claude, Codex or OpenCode, and shows checks, review threads and merge inside a pane so nothing needs opening on GitHub.
